newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israeli soldier killed in Lebanon attack.
newsitem.headline: Israeli soldier killed in Lebanon attack.

text.p: An Israeli soldier was killed and another wounded on Sunday in a clash with guerrillas inside Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone, pro-Israeli militia sources said.
In Beirut, the pro-Iranian Hizbollah guerrillas claimed responsibility for the attack.
They said a group of fighters ambushed an Israeli motorised patrol with machinegun fire and rocket-propelled grenades in Mleikh south of Jizzine, inside the occupation zone.
"Fighting is still going on," a spokesman for the group said.
